Hi Elliot,

We need to lock in a combined SOC 2 orientation + pen-test intake so our security and legal teams can confirm scope before the PO. Would Redwood be available next week for a 60–90 minute session? Prefer evenings (after 6pm PT) or early mornings (8–9am PT) — that helps our EU team join.

Attendees from our side: myself (security), Aisha Khan (Legal), and our infra lead Tim.

Attached is a rough scope doc and a list of pen-test vendor questions we want to cover. If you could propose 2–3 slots I can claim one. Also please flag any must-have preflight items (evidence, IP allowlist, bridge).

Thanks,
Samir

Samir — thanks for the note and the attachments. Availability below (all PT):

• Tue 2027-07-06 18:30–20:00 PT
• Wed 2027-07-07 08:30–10:00 PT
• Thu 2027-07-08 08:00–09:30 PT

We can run a combined session — recommended agenda: 1) quick architecture + data flow (15m), 2) SOC 2 scope and controls mapping (25m), 3) pen-test expectations and vendor questions (25–30m), 4) next steps & evidence handoff (10m).

Preflight asks from our side:
- A list of specific endpoints/domains to allow on your side for vendor IPs (if vendor runs external scanners).
- Any IP ranges or access windows for an internal-assessment variant.
- A short list of priority controls you want us to demonstrate (e.g., access logs, retention policy, key rotation).

Ben from Sales will join on the call to cover procurement cadence and any contract questions. Olga (Security Ops) will own the technical walk and evidence pointers.

If Wed 07/07 08:30 PT works, Samir can you confirm and I will send a calendar invite + bridge + agenda doc.

Elliot

Thanks all — quick legal/security note from my side before we lock the slot.

Aisha / Everledger — could you confirm whether you require a signed DPA addendum before the walkthrough? If Legal needs to review artifacts during the session we prefer the DPA in place or an NDA equivalent. If you already have a standard DPA, please share the DocuSign link and we can route to our security-legal (Ben will help expedite).

Operational ask: we typically share a read-only evidence bundle (S3 URL) post-call rather than during the live session. If you'd like live evidence, please confirm which controls are priority so we can prepare sanitized screenshots or ephemeral access tokens.

Also propose a shorter pre-call (15m) one day prior to do a quick tech-check between vendor IPs and our ops bridge. That prevents clocking over time on the main walkthrough.

Olga

--
Olga Petrov
Director, Security Operations, Redwood Inference
